title: Contextual Autoremediate Safeguard: rate-limited dry-run + circuit-breaker
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Adds a conservative, opt-in safeguard for automatic remediation workflows: contextual rate-limits, dry-run mode, and a safety circuit-breaker that pauses automated actions when error or noise thresholds are exceeded.
description: Motivation: automated remediation has reduced toil but created noisy flips during multi-incident windows. This PR introduces a contextual safeguard layer for autoremediate workflows: 1) per-service contextual rate-limits that throttle automated fixes based on recent incident velocity and on-call load, 2) a dry-run mode that records intended remediation actions without executing them (used for early rollouts and auditing), 3) an emergency circuit-breaker that pauses autoremediate across a scope when a tolerance threshold of false-positives or human rollbacks is hit, 4) audit events surfaced in the incident timeline and a dedicated metric series for autoremediate_applied/dryrun/blocked. Design summary: a lightweight policy engine (policy rules stored as YAML with precedence), a controller in slo-toolkit that evaluates candidate fixes against recent telemetry (error rates, recent autoremediate acceptance), and a pluggable executor interface that supports noop (dry-run) and live execution. Rollout plan: staged behind feature-flag rolling to 10% of teams, initial opt-in default false. Tests: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration harness that simulates incident bursts and verifies throttle behavior, end-to-end smoke that validates audit events surface to incident timeline. Operational notes: default global thresholds conservative (5 remediations per 30m per service; 20% rollback tolerance triggers circuit-break). Related: addresses recurring SUP-1124 noisy-autorem. Checklist: - [x] policy engine implementation - [x] dry-run executor + CLI toggle - [x] metric/emitter + dashboards - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and quickstart examples - [x] migration and rollback steps
